_comment: AwareWave Claude Code user-level settings template (cross-machine SSOT). Variables: ${USERPROFILE}, ${USERPROFILE_FORWARD}, ${MONOREPO_ROOT}, ${MONOREPO_ROOT_FORWARD}. Sync via scripts/sync-claude-userlevel.ps1.
_cleanupPeriodDays_comment: Conversation transcript retention. Claude Code's DEFAULT IS 30 DAYS and silently deletes older .jsonl transcripts — 2026-08-16 this destroyed the content of 9 pinned sessions (2026-06-23 ~ 2026-07-04) while their titles stayed in the sidebar, which is why the loss went unnoticed. Unrecoverable: no recycle-bin copy, no backup, and history.jsonl stops at 2026-05-23. Pinning a session does NOT exempt it. Value 0 is rejected by Claude Code. Durable knowledge still belongs in WORKLOG/TASKS/ADR/memory — this setting only widens the window, it is not a substitute.

permissions._defaultMode_comment: bypassPermissions = no per-command prompts. Only valid in user-level ~/.claude/settings.json (Claude Code ignores it in project-shared .claude/settings.json for safety). 'skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt' suppresses the one-time entry confirmation. Hard guardrails come from 'deny' below + the governance runner rules (hooks/rules/branch-protection.js, hooks/rules/dangerous-bash.js — see hooks/rules.manifest.json). See mcp/claude-userlevel/README.md.
permissions._deny_workflow_comment: Workflow (multi-agent orchestration tool) is denied outright: its agent() fan-out runs in the background where PreToolUse hooks cannot see it, so subagent-budget.js can only check a self-declared estimate. 2026-09-03 incident: 99 agents from one Workflow, 5-hour quota gone in 30 min. Fixed 4-5 role agents via the Agent tool cover every governed pattern (AGENTS.md section 5). Mirror: scripts/wire-remote-hooks.sh.

hooks._comment: Portable governance hooks run through ONE runner (hooks/runner.js); the event→rules wiring lives in hooks/rules.manifest.json — never enumerate hooks here. Only machine-level PowerShell automations (AO-RESUME trigger, post-push deploy) are wired directly.
